@[expose] def Heldout.TransposeBroadcast.Goal : Prop :=
∀ (small rank : Nat) (inputShape : Shape small) (middle : Shape rank) (perm : AxisPermutation rank)
  (axes : Fin small → Fin rank) (conditions : Conditions inputShape middle perm axes) (α : Type)
  (input : Tensor inputShape α),
  Tensor.transpose perm ⋯ (broadcast axes ⋯ input) = broadcast (movedAxes perm axes) ⋯ input
